about: The names atlas of the boats (tools/blender/boats/lettering.py; docs/boats.md). Each page is 4 x 16 cells (64), each 4:1; cell k sits at column k % 4 and row k // 4 from the top left. A cell is laid out for a board of shape `aspect` (width / height) and squeezed into the 4:1 cell, so it reads right on that board. `rect`: x, y, w, h as fractions of the page from its top left; `px` the same in pixels. Opaque RGB, sRGB: draw with linear filtering and mipmaps, no bump. `vessels`: each fleet.json id to its cells by zone (bow: both bow boards; stern: the name and port, or the owner and port; box: the paddle boxes). `spare`: cells for the registry's spare names, by kind. `names`: name, then style, then its cells. `ground`: the board colour round the letters (sRGB) by look, to paint the hull round a zone.
